summary: This bill requires federal agencies to publish all new and existing guidance documents, which are agency statements that interpret laws or regulations but do not have the force of law, in a single, organized online location designated by the Office of Management and Budget, and to indicate when such documents are rescinded.

scores.thoughts: The bill requires federal agencies to publish guidance documents on a designated internet website and maintain rescinded documents. This would involve some administrative costs for setting up and maintaining the website and for agency compliance, thus slightly increasing government spending.
